Import loadDeck from "../cards/model.js" (loadDeck(text) returns {ok: true, deck: {cards, externalDependsOn}} or {ok: false, faults: {key, message}[]}) and the type Card from "../cards/types.js"; of the Node modules only node:fs and node:path. readLastRun walks .morph/runs in DESCENDING code-unit order of the names and skips anything it cannot read; the answer-file pattern escapes the card id (an id may hold a dot). renderBrief is pure and byte-exact: blocks joined by a blank line, one final newline, the newline rule for every text between tags. No clock, no process, no console, no child process. Write no test file: a probe tests you and a judge writes the example tests.

## Function Card Brief

`morph card --deck <deck> --id <card> [--md]`: the card, its targets and slice as they read now, the last run's outcome of it; with --md the same as markdown.

Behaviour: cardBrief(root, args {deck, id, md}) → {code, document}. findCard(root, deck, id) (exported; Accept Card's first step too), in order: path.resolve(root, deck) not a regular file → {code 4, document {error {code 4, kind "UsageError", message "deck file not found: <deck as given>"}}}; cards' Load Deck on its UTF-8 text with faults → 2 DeckError "invalid deck: " + each "<key>: <message>", "; "-joined; no card with customId id → 4 UsageError "no card '<id>' in <deck> (have: <the deck's ids in deck order, ", "-joined>)"; else {ok: true, card}, a failure {ok: false, result}. The document, keys in this order: deck (as given), card (customId), intent, targets (in targets order) and slice (the contextSlice sorted by code unit, as the compiler sends it), each entry {path, text: the file's UTF-8 text under root, null when it is not a regular file}; instruction, acceptance, maxTokens, model, dependsOn (the card's, as loaded); lastRun = readLastRun(root, id) (exported); markdown = renderBrief(document) (exported, pure) only when md, else no such key. code 0. readLastRun: the names under RUNS_DIR ".morph/runs" (none, or no directory → null) in descending code-unit order (a minted run id is UTC "YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS", so the newest first; completedAt is not read); the first whose report.json is a regular file that JSON.parse reads into an object with an outcomes array holding an outcome with customId id (anything else is skipped silently) gives {runId: the name, processor: the report's string or null, status, reason (string or null), attempts (number or 0), earlierFailures: the length of its earlierFailures array (0 when absent), acceptanceLog (string or ""), answers: the files of <run>/answers/ whose name matches ^<id, regex-escaped>(\.r[0-9]+)?\.v[0-9]+\.answer\.txt$, code-unit sorted, each as ".morph/runs/<run>/answers/<name>"}; none → null. renderBrief(doc) = blocks joined by "\n\n" plus a final "\n": "# Debt brief: <card>"; "Write only: <each target path in backticks, ", "-joined>. Change no other file.\nThen: `morph accept --deck <deck> --id <card> --model <your model> --commit`."; the six lines "- deck: <deck>", "- intent: <intent>", "- maxTokens: <n or none>", "- model: <model or none>", "- dependsOn: <ids ", "-joined, or none>", "- last run: <runId>, processor <processor or none>, <status>, attempts <n>, reason <reason or none>" (or "- last run: none"), "\n"-joined; "## Instruction\n\n" + the instruction with its trailing white space trimmed; "## Acceptance\n\n" + ("none" for null, else "<acceptance>\n" + text + "</acceptance>"); only with a last run "## Last run\n\n<acceptance_log>\n" + log + "</acceptance_log>\n\nAnswers: " + the answers in backticks ", "-joined (or "none"); "## Targets now\n\n" + per target '<file path="<path>">\n' + text + "</file>" or "Target <path> does not exist yet.", "\n\n"-joined; "## Context slice\n\n" + per slice entry the same file block or "File <path> is missing.", "\n\n"-joined, or "none" for an empty slice. Every text put between tags gets a "\n" appended when it is not empty and does not end in one.

- reads: Deck File
- reads: Run Report
- produces: Card Brief Document

## Component requirements / guardrails

Requirements:
- Strict TypeScript: tsconfig strict, ESM, no `any`; every module compiles with tsc --noEmit.
- One Document Out: Every command prints exactly one JSON document on stdout and nothing else; the human log goes to stderr.
- Deterministic Core: cards and compiler give byte-identical results for the same inputs: no clock, no randomness, no environment reads. acceptance is bound only in its pure parts (Snapshot Targets, Build Attempt Diff): Run Acceptance spawns a shell and its only timer is the child's timeout; env and the timeout are parameters, never process.env (06.10, P3). processor reads the environment only in Read Registry; Assemble Request, Read Response, Stub Answer, Assemble Batch and Read Batch are pure of clock and network; the transport and its sleep are parameters of Send Generation and Send Batch (P4, P11). git spawns only in Run Git, synchronously, with the child's environment given whole as a parameter; it reads no process.env and no clock of its own (P6). cli touches the process only in its entry src/cli.ts: the environment, the working directory, the clock and the output streams reach main() as parameters, and the environment reaches the processor only through Read Registry (P7). language is pure data and pure functions: no clock, no environment, no file system, no child process; node:path is its only Node module; its shell lines are text (P8). contour reads no file, no clock and no environment: it parses the text it is given; the package yaml is imported in Parse Document alone (P9). planner reads no file, no clock and no environment: the cli reads the record and the map and passes which files exist as a function; node:path is its only Node module (P10a). builder reads no file, no clock and no environment: the caller passes the checks, the cards, the profile and the texts of the guard, the locator and the probes; node:path is its only Node module (P10b). primer reads files and spawns git (git's gitOk, the environment a parameter) only in Primer Command, the clock only there through deps.now; Read Runs, Read Story and Render Primer are pure functions of what they are given, no network anywhere (P12a). scout reads no clock, no environment and no network and spawns nothing: Parse Turn, Spend Budget and Seed From Ownership are pure; Cage Path and Run Tool reach the file system only through the ScoutFs parameter (realpath, readFile); elapsed time is a parameter; node:path is its only Node module (P13a). scout-session reaches the model only through the processor's Send Generation and the clock only through deps.now; Run Scout reads the tree through the ScoutFs parameter; Scout Command and Plan From Scout are the scout layer's two node:fs files (git through gitOk and runGit, node:crypto for the sha256 in Scout Command), the environment a parameter (P13b). reviewer's checks (Find Obligations, Check Envelope, Check Guardrails, Plan Mutants, Render Findings) are pure functions of the record, git's outputs and the texts they are given: no file, no clock, no environment, no child process, no Node module (P14a). review-session spawns only through acceptance's Run Acceptance (the mutant runs, each under its timeout) and git's Run Git; Run Mutants writes only through acceptance's Restore Snapshot; Review Command is the reviewer layer's one node:fs file (the record, the map and scout.json read, the review written), the environment a parameter, no clock and no model call (P14b). debt spawns only through acceptance's Run Acceptance and git's Run Git, reads the deck file, the card's files and the run archive through node:fs, no clock and no model call; the environment is a parameter (P17).
- Node Only: Runtime dependencies: Node 20 built-ins and the package `yaml` (the record reader), nothing else; dev dependencies pinned exactly, no ^ or ~.

Guardrails:
- No Network In Tests: tests/setup.ts makes fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket and net.connect throw "network blocked in tests"; only the processor's own transport is mocked.
- No Shell Outside Acceptance: child processes are spawned only by Run Acceptance, the git module (in Run Git alone, P6) and the processor's none; everything else is pure.
- Frozen Tree During Run: while a run is in flight no file outside the cards' targets and .morph/ changes; a changed declared input discards the answer unread.

## Function Accept Card

`morph accept --deck <deck> --id <card> --model <name> [--commit]`: the card's acceptance on the tree as it is; with --commit and green, one commit of only its targets with the debt trailers.

Behaviour: acceptCard(root, args {deck, id, model, commit}, deps {env, timeoutMs?}) → Promise of {code, document}. 1. Card Brief's findCard (its failure is the result). 2. acceptance null or blank after trim → {code 2, document {error {code 2, kind "RefusalError", message "card <id> has no acceptance"}}}. 3. With commit only: outside = changedOutside(root, targets, env) (exported): git's gitOk status --porcelain --untracked-files=all (outside a repository it throws: the promise rejects, exit 3 by main); per line the path after the two status letters and a space (a rename: the path after " -> "); a path under ".morph/" or equal to a target is dropped; the rest distinct, code-unit sorted. Taken BEFORE the acceptance: the tree the payer left. Without commit outside is null and no git runs. 4. result = acceptance's runAcceptance(acceptance, root, {env: deps.env, timeoutMs: deps.timeoutMs or DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS 300000}) — the runner's call: /bin/sh -c from root, its own process group killed on the timeout, the secret keys stripped, the log clipped. Nothing is written or rolled back: a red tree stays as the payer left it. green = exit 0. 5. reasons, in order: not green → "acceptance failed (exit <exit, or null>)"; outside not empty → "changed outside the targets: <outside ", "-joined>". With commit and no reason: git's commitPaths(root, targets, "morph <id>: <targets ", "-joined>", trailers [Morph-Card <id>, Morph-Model <model>, Morph-Acceptance-Exit 0, Morph-Debt true], env, force true) (Commit Card's subject and force; no Morph-Variant); null (the targets equal HEAD) → reason "nothing to commit: the targets equal HEAD". document {deck, card, model, exit, timedOut, green, log, outside, commit: the sha or null, diffstat or null, reason: the reasons "; "-joined, or null}, keys in that order; code 0 when green and (not commit, or a commit made), else 1.

Steps:
- calls: Card Brief
- uses: acceptance
- uses: git
- produces: Accept Document

Examples (the tests must prove each one):
1. given a tmpRepo t, one commit "base" of d.json = debt/accept.deck.json (fix-a, fix-two, slow, none, blank), src/a.ts "broken\n", README.md "r\n"; then src/a.ts written "fixed\n" and .morph/runs/x/report.json "{}\n" (untracked); env {PATH}; when acceptCard(t, {deck: "d.json", id: "fix-a", model: "claude-fable-5-1", commit: true}, {env}), then the same call again; then code 0, document {deck "d.json", card "fix-a", model "claude-fable-5-1", exit 0, timedOut false, green true, log "", outside [], commit HEAD (40 hex), diffstat {files 1, insertions 1, deletions 1}, reason null}; the HEAD message "morph fix-a: src/a.ts\n\nMorph-Card: fix-a\nMorph-Model: claude-fable-5-1\nMorph-Acceptance-Exit: 0\nMorph-Debt: true", `git show --name-only --format= HEAD` "src/a.ts"; then code 1, green true, commit null, diffstat null, reason "nothing to commit: the targets equal HEAD", HEAD unchanged (ref: tests/fixtures/debt/accept.deck.json)
2. given the same base; src/a.ts written "still broken\n"; when acceptCard with commit true; then code 1, exit 1, timedOut false, green false, log "FAIL: src/a.ts not fixed\n", outside [], commit null, reason "acceptance failed (exit 1)"; HEAD is "base"; src/a.ts still reads "still broken\n" (nothing rolled back)
3. given the same base; src/a.ts "fixed again\n", README.md "r2\n", notes/n.txt "n\n" (untracked); then src/a.ts "broken!\n"; when acceptCard with commit true, twice; then code 1, green true, outside ["README.md", "notes/n.txt"], commit null, reason "changed outside the targets: README.md, notes/n.txt"; then code 1, exit 1, reason "acceptance failed (exit 1); changed outside the targets: README.md, notes/n.txt"; HEAD is "base" after both
4. given a tmpRoot r (no git) holding d.json, src/b.ts "b\n", out/g.ts "g\n"; id fix-two, commit false, env {PATH, MARK "k7", GH_TOKEN "t"}; then MARK "k8"; then id slow with deps.timeoutMs 300; when acceptCard; then code 0, exit 0, green true, log "", outside null, commit null, diffstat null, reason null (GH_TOKEN never reaches the shell); then code 1, exit 1, reason "acceptance failed (exit 1)"; then code 1, exit null, timedOut true, log "started\nacceptance timed out after 300 ms\n", reason "acceptance failed (exit null)"
5. given a tmpRepo g, one commit "base" of d.json and .gitignore "out/\n"; src/b.ts "b\n" and out/g.ts "g\n" written; id fix-two, model "acme/m:free", commit true, env {PATH, MARK "k7"}; then ids none, blank, zz and deck "x.json" on g; then fix-a with commit true on the tmpRoot r of example 4; when acceptCard; then code 0, outside [], diffstat {files 2, insertions 2, deletions 0}, HEAD message "morph fix-two: src/b.ts, out/g.ts\n\nMorph-Card: fix-two\nMorph-Model: acme/m:free\nMorph-Acceptance-Exit: 0\nMorph-Debt: true", `git show --name-only --format= HEAD` "out/g.ts\nsrc/b.ts" (the ignored target committed); then 2 RefusalError "card none has no acceptance", "card blank has no acceptance", 4 UsageError "no card 'zz' in d.json (have: fix-a, fix-two, slow, none, blank)", "deck file not found: x.json"; then the promise rejects with an Error beginning "git status failed (exit 128): "

Data Accept Document: stdout of morph accept.
Schema:

env and the timeout are parameters, never process.env (06.10, P3). processor reads the environment only in Read Registry; Assemble Request, Read Response, Stub Answer, Assemble Batch and Read Batch are pure of clock and network; the transport and its sleep are parameters of Send Generation and Send Batch (P4, P11). git spawns only in Run Git, synchronously, with the child's environment given whole as a parameter; it reads no process.env and no clock of its own (P6). cli touches the process only in its entry src/cli.ts: the environment, the working directory, the clock and the output streams reach main() as parameters, and the environment reaches the processor only through Read Registry (P7). language is pure data and pure functions: no clock, no environment, no file system, no child process; node:path is its only Node module; its shell lines are text (P8). contour reads no file, no clock and no environment: it parses the text it is given; the package yaml is imported in Parse Document alone (P9). planner reads no file, no clock and no environment: the cli reads the record and the map and passes which files exist as a function; Cage Path and Run Tool reach the file system only through the ScoutFs parameter (realpath, readFile); elapsed time is a parameter; node:path is its only Node module (P13a). scout-session reaches the model only through the processor's Send Generation and the clock only through deps.now; Behaviour: planCommand(root, args), in order. Plan Spec({record, map, spec: args.spec, components: args.components, judge: args.judge, hasFile: a path is a regular file under root}); an error → 2 DeckError, it. With args.checks: profile = Resolve Profile(the first selected Component's language, map.language) — the Component's wins, as in the cut (P15) — an error → 2 DeckError "the map: " + it; Read Plan Checks(root, args.checks, profile) (a failure is the result); Build Acceptances({cards, checks, profile, texts}), errors → 2 DeckError "acceptances not built (<n> error|errors):\n" + them "\n"-joined; its cards replace the plan's, except a card the map gives an acceptance (map card by customId ?? id, extra card by customId). args.out not null → the cards written to path.resolve(root, args.out) as JSON.stringify(cards, null, 2) + "\n", parents created. → {code: 0, document: {spec, components, cards, generations, externalDependsOn, out: args.out}}. Callee Run Command: `morph run`: processor, deck, hazards, run branch, Run Deck, archive; one Run Document.
Behaviour: runCommand(root, args, deps, log?), every check before any git call or spend, in order. 1. readRegistry(deps.env); no config with id args.processor → 4 UsageError "processor <id> is not configured" + (": " + the messages of the faults keyed "MORPH_PROCESSOR_<id>_…", "; "-joined, when any). 2. Read Deck File (its failure is the result); no cards → 2 RefusalError "deck has no cards". 3. Find Hazards errors → 2 RefusalError "deck has <n> hazard error(s): " + each "<kind> <cards ","-joined>[ <path>]", "; "-joined; then cards whose acceptance is null or blank → 2 RefusalError "deck has <n> card(s) with no acceptance: <ids in deck order, ","-joined>". 4. start = deps.now() (its only call here); runId = args.runId or mintRunId(start) (UTC "YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS"). 5. Open Run Branch(root, runId, deps.env); a refusal → 2 RefusalError, its error. 6. Run Deck, input {root, runId, branch, deck, budget {maxCards: args.maxCards or the card count, maxRetryBatches, deadline: start + deadlineSeconds × 1000}}, deps {config, transport: {...(deps.transport or realTransport(config.timeoutMs)), saveBatch: (record) => git's saveBatchRecord(root, record)}, commit: makeCommitHook(root, config.model, deps.env), now: deps.now, env: deps.env, interrupted: deps.interrupted, onVariant: line = variantLine(record), keep {...record, line}, log given → log(line)}. 7. Archive Run(root, {runId, deck, report, answers: the kept records}, deps.env). → {code: 3 when report.fault is set (the partial report archived), else runExitCode(report, archive), document: {runId, branch, base, report, archive}}. variantLine(r) (exported) = "morph run: <r.request.customId> <verdict> stage <stages>[ <lastStage>] finish <finishReason, or none> chars <text length, or none>\n". The checkout stays on the run branch.

Callee Emit Document: One JSON document + newline on stdout; --pretty indents by 2.
Behaviour: renderDocument(doc, pretty) = JSON.stringify(doc, null, 2 when pretty) + "\n". errorDocument(code, kind, message) = {error: {code, kind, message}}, keys in that order.

Callee Classify Error: Exit codes: 0 ok; 1 a card not written; 2 a refusal before spend; 3 a fault under way; 4 a usage error.
Behaviour: classifyThrown(e) → {code: 3, document: errorDocument(3, "RuntimeError", e.message for an Error, else String(e))}. runExitCode(report, archive) → 3 when the archive is not ok; else 1 when any outcome is not "written"; else 0. Kinds: UsageError and NotYetError (4), DeckError and RefusalError (2), RuntimeError (3).
